in_marathi.name: Swetank
in_marathi.long_meaning: Swetank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Swetank is a Sanskrit and Hindu name that means 'sweet tank'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'swet' meaning 'sweet' and 'ank' meaning 'tank'. This name reflects the idea of being filled with sweetness and nectar, and evokes images of abundance and prosperity.
